basic_info.description: This stately, semi-detached residence, expanded and beautifully remodeled in 2003, occupies a commanding corner across from Sutro Park with sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean, Ocean Beach, and Sutro Park. Underground power lines ensure premium views. The light-filled main level showcases an open floor plan with oversized picture windows, inlaid wood floors, and beamed ceilings. A chef's kitchen with stone countertops, premium stainless appliances, and a cozy breakfast nook overlooks the ocean. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete this level. Upstairs, the grand primary suite impresses with vaulted, beamed ceilings, a private ocean-view terrace, spa-inspired en-suite bath, and a dedicated home office with custom cabinetry. The lower level offers a generous family/media room with a wet bar, built-in cabinetry, and a third full bath. French doors open to a private garden patio, perfect for entertaining. A large garage with storage and laundry adds convenience. With its unrivaled location across from Sutro Park, the home provides easy access to great schools, Land's End trails and views, Ocean Beach, the Sunset dunes, the Beach Chalet, and Golden Gate Parkplus nearby Safeway, cafs, and public transit
